newsitem.title: INDIA: Twin India train incidents injure at least 28.
newsitem.headline: Twin India train incidents injure at least 28.

text.p: At least 15 people were injured on Monday in an explosion on a passenger train in southern India, local news agencies said.
More than a dozen others, including a junior minister, were injured when another train derailed near the capital, New Delhi, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
United News of India (UNI) said a bomb caused the explosion on the train in the southern state of Karnataka, but PTI said authorities had not yet determined the cause of the blast.
UNI said 16 people were injured. PTI said at least 15 were hurt.
PTI quoted a local police officer as saying the train was near Kolar, about 70 km (40 miles) northeast of the Karnataka capital Bangalore, when the explosion occurred.
The train had started its trip in Madurai in neighbouring Tamil Nadu state and was headed to Bangalore, the agencies said.

In the second incident, at least 13 passengers including junior Chemicals and Fertilisers Minister Shees Ram Ola were injured when 11 carriages derailed near Mahendergarh town, about 135 km (85 miles) southeast of New Delhi, PTI said.
It was the second train accident in Haryana state in the past week.
On July 28, at least 15 people died and more than 100 were injured when a crowded passenger train rammed into the rear of another train near the industrial town of Faridabad.
